summary: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory filed an 8-K reporting a board-approved sale-leaseback of its Durango, Colorado headquarters and production facility to American Heritage Legacies, LLC, an entity controlled by the family of Interim CEO Allen Harper, for $6.6 million, supported by an independent appraisal. The purchase agreement was signed September 30, 2026, with closing expected on or about October 15, 2026. Net proceeds repay $6.6 million of 12% promissory notes owed to board-affiliated lenders Steven Craig and Jeffrey Geygan. A concurrent ten-year lease carries $624,000 first-year rent, 2% annual escalators, and a change-of-control buyback at the greater of $6.93 million or appraised value; disinterested directors and the audit committee approved the related-party transaction.
